title: ichnaea.project/1 (reader)
description: The project config, as plain data: what several suites share, such as workers and datasets.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors. A JSONC project file carries it.

schema.description: The record type and its major version.

file.description: A path, relative to the declaring file.

repo.description: The repository, as `git clone` takes it.

path.description: A file or directory in the repository.

git.description: A git repository at a full commit.

fromEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the value.

oneOf.description: A URL that the environment holds, such as a presigned URL.

digest.description: The digest that the fetched file must have.

command.description: The command that fetches the files, run with the user's tools.

output.description: The directory or file that the command writes.

env.description: The environment variables that the command may read.

datasets.description: Named datasets. Each source holds a dataset.json at its root.

command.description: The command that starts the worker, run in the arm's directory.

prepare.description: A command that each arm runs in its own directory before its worker starts.

secret.description: Whether the value is a secret, which Ichnaea scrubs from what it writes.

env.description: The environment variables that the worker may read.

envFile.description: A file of secrets to load. Only the variables listed in env pass.

endpoints.description: The endpoints from the project config that the worker calls.

capacity.description: How many trials one worker process takes at a time. Default 1.

processes.description: How many worker processes run. Default 1.

startTimeout.description: How long a worker may take to be ready. Default PT10M.

provider.description: The provider that serves the endpoint.

region.description: The region that serves the endpoint.

concurrency.description: The most trials that may run at once on the endpoint. Default 4.

requestsPerMinute.description: The most requests per minute. No limit when absent.

tokensPerMinute.description: The most tokens per minute. No limit when absent.

endpoints.description: Named model endpoints and their budgets.

store.description: The local store of runs, records and artifacts.

workflow.description: The workflow file that records baselines.

githubArtifact.description: The artifacts of a successful push run of the workflow on the branch.

from.description: Where stored baselines come from. Default store.

freshness.description: The oldest stored baseline to use. Default P7D.

maxFreshness.description: The largest freshness that a suite may set. Default P30D.

share.description: The share of base cases that each fast run re-runs. Default 0.1.

min.description: The fewest complete sentinel cases. At least 5, and the default.

sentinel.description: The sample of base cases that a fast run re-runs to detect drift.

trials.description: Trials per case per version. Default 2.

profile.description: The profile that runs by default. Default pr.

artifactBytes.description: The largest artifact of a trial, in bytes.

outputBytes.description: The largest output of a trial, in bytes.

trialDeadline.description: The time bound of one trial, net of throttle waits.

wallClockMax.description: The wall-clock cap of one trial attempt, throttle waits included.

missingMax.description: The largest share of an arm's planned trials that may be missing.

throttleMax.description: How long one call may wait to get through before the trial stops.

defaults.description: Defaults that a suite, a profile or a flag overrides.

maxExposure.description: The highest exposure that the sink may receive.

purpose.description: The purpose under which it receives it.

clearance.description: A grant above the sink's default clearance.

fromEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the value.

url.description: The sink's URL, a bearer secret, from the environment.

signingKey.description: The Standard Webhooks signing key, from the environment.

maxExposure.description: The highest exposure that the sink may receive.

purpose.description: The purpose under which it receives it.

clearance.description: A grant above the sink's default clearance.

fromEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the value.

required.description: A failed delivery changes the exit code. Default false.

delivery.description: Where cards go. Default: the console and file sinks.

history.description: Directories of earlier runs that counts and trends read.

fromEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the value.

homeKey.description: The owner's secret key for keyed aliases, from the environment.

consent.description: The path of the consent list, never the list.

home.description: The place inside the controller's trust boundary where runs on real data happen.

enabled.description: Whether commands may run for the purpose.

basis.description: The legal basis, which decides who runs: consented, or also listed, subjects.

record.description: The record that documents the processing, such as a DPIA.

purposes.description: The purposes that may send content to it.

trainsOnInputs.description: Whether the provider trains on inputs. Sealed content needs false.

pseudonymous.description: How long pseudonymous data is kept.

personal.description: How long personal data is kept.

labels.description: How long each study's labels are kept.

retention.description: How long data above class none is kept.
